customer_group_hint: Choose “All customers”, or a group to aim the rule at. A rule tied to a group beats the same rule without one.
priority_hint: Wins when two rules are equally specific.
name_hint: A label you will recognise later, e.g. Ramadan Promo.
percentage_max: A percentage discount cannot be more than {max}.
delete_description: This rule will be deleted for good — it does not go to Trash and cannot be restored. To stop it pricing new sales without losing it, switch it off instead.
